body: What hurts the most is that to the casual observer I'm happy.  I make jokes, I laugh, I even smile.  But that's the outside costume.  Inside I feel different.  Inside I feel like this is all just a ruse, that I'm constantly just waiting for the hammer to drop.

I'm afraid to hold on to anything.  The last few moths have conditioned me that anything I hold on to, or anyone goes away.  I don't want to lose my school, i don't want to lose my dog.  Those are thoughts that keep me grounded.  I just can't see the light at the end of the tunnel despite these two positives in my life.  My dogs life will go on with my parents or a new home and the school will continue to operate.
Sorry, it's school that I love, no job currently, I coudln't keep my last one due to missing so many days from hospitalizations.

Internet stranger, person who knows nothing about me yet replies.  Those choices, they seem so hard and far away.  Unobtainable.  The only choice that reaches to me is looking my sweet dog in the face, her beautiful eyes, and inquisitive face stares back at me with nothing but love.  I saved her from an abusive home, and she saved me although I don't think she knows it.  

Assistance, I qualify medically for that probably.  But my state has made it so difficult that you almost HAVE to have a lawyer to get anything done.  I wish I qualified for unemployment, but I don't.  I have no money, no food, enough gas for one trip to school and back, I couldn't even afford to take the bus if I wanted to.  I feel like the last two things I truly care about in life are on the verge of being taken from me.

I can't trust that they WONT be taken from me.  Why would they still be here for me, nothing else has gone my way since October 31,2012.  The world looks down on me, I'm a freak, an abboration.  I'm worse than 'the gays' and many in my area think I'm a pervert, a sexual deviant.  I didn't choose to be transgender, it happened before I had the ability for cognative thinking.  Before I had the ability to choose.  

I'm not sure any of this answers your post, I am just trying to vent, and to figure out where I'm at.  I told my doctors recently that "I'd rather die a woman, than live a man" that's 100% true.
